title: Sandbox probe protocol
description: The inter-process contract between a contract-test harness and the probe binary it forks: the argument syntax, the exit codes, the probes, and the error codes each probe accepts. Published as data because a binding in another language ships its own probe, and the two only interoperate if they agree on the numbers.

invocation.description: How the harness passes the probe its instructions.

repeated.description: Which occurrence wins if an argument is repeated. Normative: a binding using its language's default 'last wins' parser is otherwise quietly incompatible.

exitCodes.description: Every code the protocol assigns meaning to. A probe MUST NOT signal a contract outcome with any other code.

probes.description: The probes, in the order the harness runs them.

arg.description: What the harness passes as --arg, or the empty string when the probe takes none.

success.description: The exit-code name this probe reports when the sandbox behaved as declared.

skippedWhen.description: Conditions under which the harness does not run this probe at all.

errorCodes.description: Which underlying failures count as the sandbox doing its job. The two sets are NOT disjoint.
